reformulation: Exact solver-blind reduction of MPS dws008-01: 11,096/6,064 -> 10,768/5,456 vars/rows by fixing 160 impossible interval selectors to zero and 28 indicators to one, eliminating 84 binary alias pairs, 28 d=t copies and 28 weighted auxiliaries; 629 rows dropped, 464 rewritten, 21 weight-cap rows added, 28 flow bounds tightened from 100 to exact suffix-cut bounds (11.69,10.02,8.35,6.68,5.01,3.34,1.67) and 168 objective coefficients transferred to retained aliases.
claim_class: 3 directional claims over one explicit affine/zero reconstruction: forward bijection source->target (reverse=false, objective Equal, 10,768-pair retained-coordinate projection, inverse=1) plus two reverse inclusions target->source with the same reconstruction (integer then LP, inverse 0/None); obligations 55,165 / 56,373 / 38,997, discharged by 45,938 Lin + 272 EqPair + 148 Cases (296 branch Witnesses) + 188 Round steps, 0 points, 148 branches.
claims: Claim 0 (reverse=false, input/output_integers=true, inverse=1): the 10,768 retained target coordinates are projected identically and the 328 eliminated source coordinates lift by Fixed(188) / Copy(112) / Affine(28), with 21,536 of its 55,165 obligations discharged by plain 'Exact'.

Claims 1 and 2 (reverse=true, integer then LP, inverse=0/None) are objective-preserving target->source inclusions under the same reconstruction, 56,373 and 38,997 obligations; claim 2 drops all integer obligations (22,381 -> 11,425 'Exact').

The 148 rewritten conditional upper rows t+(U-u)y<=U are proved by a Cases split on the integer selector, the y=1 branch adding the (61-U) slack term (tools/prepare_test41.py:30; RPA step Cases id 115).

The 160 selectors fixed to zero and 28 nonempty-selection rows are discharged by Round on an integer Lin fact (tools/prepare_test41.py:26,35) - the preparer insists on 'no idealized decimals', so encoded terminating decimals are never rounded to 2/3-style rationals.

28 flow-cut bounds come from exact row sums of the c813-c820 balance equalities minus nonnegativity of incoming arcs (tools/prepare_test41.py:15), and c820 is removed as the negative sum of the other seven (tools/prepare_test41.py:105).
proof_encoding: RPA 2 header + one compact JSON line (7,549,075 B -> RPX 4,842,168 B; request.json 388,181 B); 3 blocks, one per claim, steps 1,666 / 22,292 / 22,292 and Return.map sizes 10,768 / 11,096 / 11,096.

Step shapes used: Lin{id,kind,constant,terms[[Ref,Rat]]}, EqPair{positive:RowLower,negative:RowUpper}, Cases{expression,split,integer:VarInt,left/right{steps,end:Witness}}, Round{le:Local,integer:VarInt}; 296 nested branch Witnesses.

References mix constructed facts ({EqPair:86},{Round:147}) with unconstructed atoms ({VarLower:244},{RowEq:816},{VarUpper:w},{VarInt:y}), which is how the 148 Cases and 188 Rounds replace explicit big-M algebra.
Obligations are a flat list of Ref-or-'Exact' entries: 33,629 + 21,536 (claim 0), 33,992 + 22,381 (claim 1), 27,572 + 11,425 (claim 2); no points, no bijections, 148 branches reported by verify.

verify of the whole 3-claim contract: 0.53 s wall / 416.5 ms execute on the first run; assemble ~0.09 s, canonical 0.12 s per model - resource limits are nowhere near binding (RPA text is 2.8% of the 256 MiB cap).
agent_manual_work: Two independently written MPS readers with Fraction arithmetic (token parser and field-slice parser) plus a third inside the preparer chain; the first attempt died on 'assert v in bounds' because 28 continuous columns have no BOUNDS record.

All structural discovery by ad-hoc defaultdict grouping in eval cells: proportional row groups (84 alias pairs), column/occurrence grouping, arc extraction from +1/-1 occurrences over c813-c820, 28 interval blocks, incidence components.

Hand-built certificate data now living in audit.json: 28 flow arcs with suffix-cut witnesses, 84 alias pairs, 28 interval blocks with per-selector lower/upper rows, weights, U and new cap rows, plus 114,688 enumerated masks (3,440 kept, 111,248 proved infeasible).

A hand-written MPS writer (exact_decimal, paired COLUMNS records, INTORG/INTEND marker bookkeeping, RHS/BOUNDS emission) plus a 578,752 B audit.json serializer and the reproducible verify.py oracle; the committed target exists only because the agent wrote it.
Scratch oracle work: interval_from_rows to compare exact feasible t-intervals, and the t=0.5 two-active-selector counterexample that killed the one-hot hypothesis.

tools/prepare_test41.py:82 wbound(i,upper,e) - the weighted auxiliary that is not box-implied, rescued either by the new cap row or by min-coefficient rescaling of the definition row.

tools/prepare_test31.py:47 run_receipt - hand-rolled artifact plumbing: writes RPA 2, runs canonical x2 / assemble / verify / determinism assemble / 3 mutations, records the receipt.
friction: Failing call 1: the agent's own parser asserted 'v in bounds' for every column; 28 continuous columns (VAR513-VAR540) have no BOUNDS record and default to [0,+inf). It cost a turn and a written caveat (report section 2).
Failing call 2: a NameError on 'In' while trying to re-read a previous eval cell - the analysis loop has no supported way to reuse earlier cell source, so the whole parser was retyped twice.
23 turns / 796 s wall / 58.1k chars of eval code went into discovery and audit scripting, while the delivered certificate comes from a 123-line preparer that only replays audit.json.

No public proof-construction API: typed builders exist only under crates/core/tests/*_builder.rs and crate-private src/build_support.rs, so the preparer carries its own Ref/Expr algebra, residual asserts and hard-coded globals such as 'assert len(eliminated)==328' (tools/prepare_test41.py:39).

Silent precondition failures: bounded(e) asserts instead of returning NotImplied for a non-box-implied obligation, and f.refexpr(ref)==e asserts are repeated at nearly every rule call to catch mis-built steps.
